description: Machine-readable source for Green Goods vocabulary enforcement. The linter reads linter_enforced, renamed_terms, us_spelling, and pt_brazilian; the docs audit reads us_spelling; the agent's copy tests read us_spelling, linter_enforced, and renamed_terms for the chat copy. Prompt-only lists guide design agents and are projected into the public glossary.

linter_enforced.scope: user-facing strings in i18n JSON message values, and the agent's chat copy in every language (its i18n test)
linter_enforced.rationale: These terms signal growth-hacking or FOMO patterns that conflict with the regenerative design review lens. See DESIGN.md and .claude/skills/design/review-checklist.md.

renamed_terms.scope: user-facing strings and keys in i18n JSON message catalogs, and the agent's chat copy (its i18n and locale-terms tests)
renamed_terms.rationale: The garden role is a Steward. Deployed GardenRole and isOperator wire names remain code identifiers; visible role copy uses Steward. The exempt key refers to literal solar field technicians.
renamed_terms.locale_terms_rationale: Locked visible terms on every surface (decided 2026-10-18): steward is es responsable, pt responsável; garden is es jardín, pt jardim. Each list holds the English words and the synonyms that drifted in before. locale_allowed_phrases names, per key, the exact proper-name phrase the check removes before matching (Gardens is the conviction-voting product; Green Goods Community Garden is a garden's name), so any other occurrence of a listed word in that key still fails. Participante, compromiso and custodia are correct elsewhere, so they are not listed; the shared locale-coverage test guards dotación and dotação, and requires promesa / promessa wherever English says promise. The agent's es and pt chat copy is held to the same lists by packages/agent/src/__tests__/locale-terms.test.ts. ICU argument names are code and are skipped.

us_spelling.scope: English copy: i18n catalog values (globs, check-vocab.sh), hand-written docs, release notes, design guidance and the docs site's components (docs-audit.mjs), and the agent's English chat copy (its i18n test); keys, code, URLs and ICU argument names are skipped
us_spelling.rationale: English copy uses US spelling (decided 2026-10-17; DESIGN.md § Voice & Copy). Each UK form maps to the US word to use. A third-party name or title quoted in its own spelling goes in exempt_keys (a catalog message) or exempt_phrases (docs and agent copy).

pt_brazilian.scope: Portuguese catalog values and the QA app's Portuguese locale (globs, check-vocab.sh), nested values included; keys and ICU argument names are skipped
pt_brazilian.rationale: The Portuguese catalog is Brazilian Portuguese with você (confirmed 2026-10-21). European forms had drifted in, mostly in the cockpit pool copy, and were rewritten then. Each term and pattern here is European in this register: tu forms and the -te clitic, the está a + infinitive progressive, registado, equipa, secção, boleia, ecrã, utilizador, ficheiro, partilhar, contactar, planear, European accents such as económico, «» quotes, and precisa de ligação for a connection. Forms that are also Brazilian are left to review: ligação for a call or a link, de facto, partilha, à espera, a confirmar (to be confirmed), passa a + infinitive, está a par, Aceite as an imperative, precisas (also the adjective precise) and consola (also the verb consolar).

prompt_vocabulary_admin_banned.scope: AI-prompt vocabulary for admin-cockpit screens; guidance only
prompt_vocabulary_admin_banned.rationale: Admin is a restrained steward cockpit. Hero moments belong to the client PWA. Glass is restricted to Navigation and FAB chrome; dense surfaces remain solid.

prompt_vocabulary_client_banned.scope: AI-prompt vocabulary for client PWA screens; guidance only
prompt_vocabulary_client_banned.rationale: The client PWA is a garden journal, not a steward cockpit. It uses warm narrative copy and Inter; cockpit and KPI language belongs to admin.

consumers.reads: us_spelling for hand-written docs, release notes and design guidance
us_spelling for the agent's English chat copy, and linter_enforced and renamed_terms for its copy in every language
renamed_terms.locale_terms for the agent's es and pt chat copy
all sections for the generated glossary
